maggie: customer hit a streaming hang in the Python SDK when using SSE. generator never yields end-of-stream after a partial token, blocks forever.
maggie: reported from prod, small volume, reproducible in our staging with their workload. they saw last data chunk end mid-token (e.g. '\"conte') and server closed connection. generator just waits.
ev an: can you paste the minimal repro and the SDK version?
maggie: repro below and logs. sdk==0.2.9. code: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
cli = RedwoodClient(api_key=ENV)
resp = cli.stream("chat.completions", model="rw-lite", input=prompt)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk)
```
maggie: curl/netcat shows server emitted:
```
data: {"delta":"Hel"
\n\n
data: {"delta":"lo"}\n\n```
then final chunk was truncated: `data: {"delta":" world\n` and connection close.
logs: `python-sdk: waiting on event delimiter, buffer='data: {"delta":" world\n'`

ev an: ok. looks like our SSE parser expects a blank line separator before emitting an event. if the server closes mid-event we should emit partial and close.
can you try a quick patch: in stream() set `emit_partial_on_close=True` (local patch) and rerun?
maggie: tried with a local patch that emits partial on close, generator returns final partial token but then downstream code raises JSONDecodeError when trying to json.loads on truncated payload. customer wants best-effort text delivery instead of crash.
lucas: pinging runtime team. probable bug: parser uses `.split('\n\n')` which fails when `\n\n` boundary crosses chunk boundaries. plus we buffer until delimiter indefinitely.
ci-bot: CI pipeline for pr #3412 started by lucas.
lucas: workaround for customer: catch JSONDecodeError around assembling deltas, fallback to using the raw buffer string (strip trailing incomplete code point) or join with last stable token. example: `try: obj=json.loads(buf) except JSONDecodeError: obj={'delta': buf}`. not perfect but graceful.
ev an: we should add a robust SSE splitter that handles chunk boundaries and a timeout/close handler to flush buffer. file a bug and include steps.
maggie: filed escalation ticket INC-2026 with logs, repro, and stack trace. attaching tcpdump soon. customer asking for ETA.
lucas: assigned bug RED-998. I'll open a PR that changes parser to incremental state machine + test for split-delimiter case. ETA EOD tomorrow.
ev an: can we release a patch 0.2.10 hotfix to support emit_partial_on_close flag as a stopgap?
lucas: yes, will include flag + unit tests + docs. also add note to support playbook about handling truncated SSE events.
maggie: told customer we'll provide patched wheel and instructions to apply workaround if they can't upgrade. :thumbsup:
ev an: add a test case to reproducer folder: simulate chunk boundary inside '\n\n' and a server close. ensure generator yields final partial.
maggie: adding repro steps to ticket: run `python repro/sse_trunc_repro.py --chunksize 8` and confirm hang, then with patched wheel confirm stream terminates with final partial.
lucas: PR #3412 opened, requesting review.
ci-bot: build passed for PR #3412.
ev an: thanks team. follow up tomorrow if customer needs org-level workaround.
